# Maison Tislit

> Maison Tislit is a luxury e-commerce website for a Moroccan feminine fashion brand based in Hoofddorp, Netherlands. It specializes in artisanal Moroccan garments — djellabas, gandouras and caftans — reinvented for the modern woman. The site is bilingual (English and Dutch), uses Supabase for the backend, and offers ordering via WhatsApp, by appointment, or by email.

The site is served at https://maisontislit.com. It supports two locales: English (`/en/`) and Dutch (`/nl/`). All content pages exist under both locale prefixes.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://maisontislit.com/en/): Landing page with hero, brand story, category highlights, and featured collection.
- [Shop](https://maisontislit.com/en/shop): Full product catalog with filtering by category, sorting, and quick-view product modals.
- [About](https://maisontislit.com/en/about): Brand story and the atelier behind Maison Tislit.
- [Contact](https://maisontislit.com/en/contact): Contact form (protected by Cloudflare Turnstile), atelier visit information, wholesale, and press inquiries.
- [Cart](https://maisontislit.com/en/cart): Shopping cart and cart management.
- [Checkout](https://maisontislit.com/en/checkout): Order placement with WhatsApp confirmation and shipping details.
- [Account](https://maisontislit.com/en/account): Customer account, order history, and saved favorites.
- [Shipping](https://maisontislit.com/en/shipping): Shipping and delivery policy.
- [Returns](https://maisontislit.com/en/returns): Returns and exchanges policy.

## Product Categories

- [Djellaba](https://maisontislit.com/en/shop/djellaba): Traditional Moroccan djellabas.
- [Gandoura](https://maisontislit.com/en/shop/gandoura): Graceful Moroccan gandouras.
- [Caftan](https://maisontislit.com/en/shop/caftan): Embroidered Moroccan caftans.

> Note: Individual product pages share the pattern `/en/product/<slug>` (e.g. `/en/product/emerald-royal-djellaba`). The full product catalog and slugs are served dynamically from Supabase and are also indexed in the [XML sitemap](https://maisontislit.com/sitemap.xml).
